scripts.test:bridge: cd test/bridge && uv run --with pytest python -m pytest -q
scripts.build:native: mkdir -p bin && swiftc -O native/hermes-midi/main.swift -o bin/hermes-midi && swiftc -O native/window-id/main.swift -o bin/window-id
scripts.install:live: mkdir -p "$HOME/Music/Ableton/User Library/Remote Scripts" && ln -sfn "$PWD/live/Hermes" "$HOME/Music/Ableton/User Library/Remote Scripts/Hermes" && echo 'Linked. In Live: Settings > Tempo & MIDI > Control Surface: Hermes'
scripts.install:hermes: H=${HERMES_HOME:-$HOME/.hermes}; mkdir -p "$H/plugins" && ln -sfn "$PWD/plugin/actual-assistant-engineer" "$H/plugins/actual-assistant-engineer" && hermes plugins enable actual-assistant-engineer
scripts.test:engine: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest -q test/engine
